Born at Sandwich, Massachusetts, 6 November 1694, eldest son of Joseph and Ann Holway.
Married Hannah Soule of Dartmouth, whose brother Benjamin married his sister Mary at Sandwich in 1721;
their daughter Elsie married Eliphalet Stephens in 1751.
Born at Dartmouth, Massachusetts, 1 June 1694, daughter of William Soule and Hannah Eaton,
and great-granddaughter of two Mayflower passengers, George Soule and Francis Eaton.
A Quaker, she was disowned by the Dartmouth Monthly Meeting in 1721 for marrying Joseph Holway of Sandwich outside
